x: There is nothing unusual about the training of Iharos, Chataway, Zatopek, Pirie, Norris Hewson and the rest - these men are quite normal individuals - everyone can adopt the same technique but the work involved must be built up over a number of years.

His 25 KM. performance ranks him fourth in the World Best-ever, behind Zatopek, Popov and Norris! His 3 mile split times were 15.37; 15.34; 15.40; 15.48 and 15.50 - remarkable consistency for an athlete who had never previously raced further than 10 miles.
Mel Batty won in 48:13.4 which was 3rd fastest time ever, behind Heatley and Zatopek. It's good to see Colin Clair back in the Belgrave fold again.

I must say they do make a difference from running round the streets of London in ex-WD army boots, Zatopek style! Editor's Note: Could this new member be Belgrave's answer to the legendary Wilson and Alf Tupper (Britain's first four minute smiler)?
He always kept up with the times and would ask after John Regis, John Gladwin and Gary Staines with the same fervour as he once spoke of Nurmi and Zatopek.
